summary.headline: Your old website content is saved, and the Facebook access request is with Creative One.
summary.body: Done: contacts moved from CRM Boost and roomvu, domain fixed, old automations paused, and your old website content saved in Google Drive. Next: first newsletter, booking calendar and texting registration. Still open: the website is down, and we are waiting on Creative One for Facebook access.
summary.needs_you: Yilian: cancel CRM Boost and upload your files to Google Drive. Maria: record your voice reading. Both: send any saved Home or About pages and your logo.

tasks.task: Our own login to your GHL account
tasks.note: Every change we make is traceable to us.

tasks.task: Logins and email links use your own domain
tasks.note: Now app.flretirementsolutions.com and links.flretirementsolutions.com.

tasks.task: Company name set to Florida Retirement Solutions
Account time zone set to Eastern
tasks.note: Appointments and emails follow Miami time, including daylight saving.

tasks.task: Website loads at www.flretirementsolutions.com
tasks.note: As of Nov 8 the www address still shows a "page not found" message. We reconnected the domain and asked GHL support to look into it. Getting it back online is our top fix.

tasks.task: Website loads without the www
tasks.note: Still shows an error as of Nov 8. We will fix it together with the www address.

tasks.task: Domain set to renew automatically
tasks.note: Auto-renew is on. Next renewal Mar 14, 2027.

tasks.task: Business texting registration
tasks.note: Your new local number, (786) 404-9960, is in your account. We emailed it to Maria on Nov 6. The old 888 number has been cancelled. Next we submit the business texting registration. Approval takes 2 to 4 weeks after we submit.

tasks.task: Pause old automations before importing data
tasks.note: All older automations are paused, so nothing goes out to your moved contacts by mistake.

tasks.task: Not affiliated with the Florida Retirement System line
tasks.note: Already in the newsletter footer. Website footer is next. Needs compliance review.

tasks.task: Review of your roomvu account
Decision: move newsletter and posts into GHL
tasks.note: Listings are dropped. roomvu gets cancelled before its Jan 27 renewal.

tasks.task: Decision: who approves, and which languages
tasks.note: Your team approves. Newsletter in English and Spanish.

tasks.task: Newsletter assistant built inside your GHL
tasks.note: It finds the news, writes each issue in Maria's voice and saves a draft for approval. On the Nov 5 call we agreed on about four sections each week, built from your own resource library. Nothing goes to subscribers on its own.

tasks.task: Checked FRS tips and the weekly automatic run
tasks.note: Each tip is confirmed against official FRS pages before it can be used.

tasks.task: Newsletter design in GHL with your disclaimer
tasks.note: Nov 5: we are starting test newsletters with different sections for you to review. Maria's photo goes in the footer.

tasks.task: First newsletter sent from GHL
tasks.note: After you approve it, and once the roomvu newsletter is turned off. roomvu stays on for social posts for now.

tasks.task: Spanish edition of the newsletter
tasks.note: Written in Spanish from the start, not translated.

tasks.task: Social posts move to GHL
Export roomvu data and cancel
tasks.note: We will remind you and prepare the exports.

tasks.task: Move clients and leads from CRM Boost
tasks.note: 1,211 clients and leads are in GHL with their notes, birthdays and Issue Dates. No SSNs or full policy numbers came over. A backup copy is kept for 30 days.

tasks.task: Move notes and documents from CRM Boost
tasks.note: All notes moved into GHL. Account documents are saved in our secure Google Drive.

tasks.task: DROP list follow-up starting 6 months before each date
New-client thank-you and anniversary reminders
tasks.note: Starts with your most recent new client.

tasks.task: GHL booking calendar to replace Calendly
tasks.note: Nov 5: intro calls on Tuesdays and Thursdays, 8 AM to 5 PM, checked against Maria's personal Google calendar so nothing is double booked. Maria is assigned, with your intake form before booking. The newsletter booking button will link here.

tasks.task: Appointment reminders and no-show follow-up
tasks.note: Confirmation, reminders 24 hours, 1 hour and 5 minutes before, a thank-you after the call, and up to 3 messages offering a new time after a missed call. Built, not turned on yet.

tasks.task: AI phone assistant and missed-call text back
Lead and client follow-up journeys
tasks.note: Nov 5: the first new-lead follow-up is built and the plan is set: ads and posts in English and Spanish lead to a short form and a booked call. Booked calls must be confirmed by the lead before they land on the calendar. Not turned on yet.

tasks.task: New-client welcome steps and secure client portal
tasks.note: Agreed on the Nov 5 call as a next priority. We will check with F and G, North American and Nationwide whether they can let us know when a policy is approved, so the portal invite goes out on its own.

tasks.task: Brand voice from your interviews and videos
tasks.note: First version built from your interview and one YouTube video.

tasks.task: Your own domain and GHL sub-account
Free agent training funnel, English and Spanish
tasks.note: Starts once you pick the video.

tasks.task: Information advantage interview
Links to your YouTube videos
Pick the video for your free agent training
Send recordings you haven't published
Redo the personal interview with life stories
tasks.note: Childhood, family, the stories beyond the business.

tasks.task: Questions after reading the growth plan
Move roomvu contacts into GHL
tasks.note: The last 158 roomvu contacts were added on Nov 5. The rest, about 1,080, were matched to people already in GHL. All are tagged for the newsletter.

tasks.task: Recover your old website content
tasks.note: Saved in your Old Website folder in Google Drive: the Services, Resources and Contact pages, all 9 blog posts and the photos we could find. Anything we reuse gets a compliance review first.

tasks.task: Client reviews and Google Business Profile
tasks.note: Confirmed by email on Oct 29: a simple way to ask clients for reviews, plus your Google Business Profile. Nov 5: we will ask for reviews when a policy is delivered.

tasks.task: Library for carrier materials and FRS tips
tasks.note: Maria's FRS presentations are being saved and sorted in the shared Google Drive, with the Spanish versions on the way. They will also become free guides in English and Spanish.

tasks.task: Forward the old website DNS email
Give Meghan admin access to GoDaddy and Cloudflare
tasks.note: Added on the Oct 29 call.

tasks.task: Upload the FRS presentations and tips
tasks.note: Into the shared Google Drive folder, including the Spanish versions.

tasks.task: Upload logos, colors, photos and videos
tasks.note: Into the shared Google Drive folder.

tasks.task: Shared Google Drive project folder
tasks.note: Business documents, brand, marketing and assets all live here.

tasks.task: Decision: newsletter goes out once a week
Spot check the 35 CRM Boost files with broken links
tasks.note: Yilian confirmed none of the 35 broken files are needed.

tasks.task: Pick your new local texting number
tasks.note: Yilian picked option 1 on Nov 4. Calls to the new number will forward to Maria's cell.

tasks.task: Cancel CRM Boost
tasks.note: All your contacts and notes are safely in GHL.

tasks.task: Admin access to your Facebook page and ad account
tasks.note: Maria emailed Creative One on Nov 9 asking for full admin access. We are waiting for their reply.

tasks.task: Send the Facebook access email to Creative One
tasks.note: Maria sent it to Creative One on Nov 9, with Meghan copied.

tasks.task: Record 30 to 35 minutes of reading out loud
tasks.note: For your video presenter in the free webinar.

tasks.task: Email the list of insurance companies you work with
tasks.note: From the Nov 5 call. F and G, North American and Nationwide are noted already.

tasks.task: Send any saved Home, About or Events pages and your logo
tasks.note: These were not in the web archive. Upload them to the shared Google Drive if you have them.

tasks.task: Your questions: newsletter for contacts in your inbox, and moving Dropbox files into GHL
tasks.note: Maria asked on Nov 9. We replied with a quick question about how those emails are sorted, and we will go over both on Thursday's call.

dates.detail: 10:30 AM ET (9:30 AM CT), every Thursday
